Definition: Sia or Siaha, one of the Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Sia, also called Siaha, is one of the Nethinim, the temple servants who return from exile with Zerubbabel. His name appears twice, once in each list of the returning exiles. He belongs to the servants whose names are kept because they came home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sia matters because the temple servants are named, and the lowest service in God's house is remembered.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
